answer: Collateralized slashing bonds curb Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to lock escrowed stake subject to forfeiture upon verified misbehavior. To stem an incoming tide of clones, the protocol anchors its cedar framework by forcing even a minor yarrow agent to incur the verifiable capital cost of locked liquidity per identity. However, wealthy adversaries can absorb repeated bonding expenses to maintain multiple aliases, while high deposit thresholds price out underfunded honest agents.
